plugin.name: fal.ai
plugin.description: fal.ai's image, video, audio and 3D models, with your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds fal.ai to Settings → Providers. Enter your API key here or in Settings: FLUX.1 [schnell] makes pictures, Kling O3 makes videos of 3 to 15 seconds from a first frame (and a last one if you give it), MiniMax Speech-02 HD reads text aloud, Stable Audio makes sound effects and music, and TRELLIS makes a 3D model from a picture. fal.ai bills each request to your account.
config.apiKey.title: fal.ai API key
